verdict.rationale: Cline can run commands and tests and react to their output live, which covers reproducing issues and verifying fixes (e.g. "run tests and fix failures"). It can read, search, and explore the codebase through Plan mode and parallel research subagents, which supports narrowing down root causes. It also uses a browser and can work from screenshots of visual bugs, with checkpoints and one-click undo to back out failed fix attempts. Missing for 10: no dedicated debugging workflow or debugger integration docs (breakpoints, stack-trace analysis), and no independent or hands-on reports of end-to-end reproduce-diagnose-verify loops.
